_comment: Companion mods for RealEarth. NOT redistributed here - this manifest points at the
authors' own files on Modrinth's CDN, pinned to exact versions and checked by SHA-512.
Why a manifest and not bundled jars: all of these are copyleft (MPL-2.0, GPL-3.0,
LGPL-3.0). Redistribution is permitted but carries obligations, the files go stale the
day they update, and shipping other people's jars is not how the Minecraft ecosystem
works. Fetching from source keeps attribution and licensing where they belong.
Every one of these is OPTIONAL. RealEarth runs without all of them.

mods.name: Better Clouds
mods.why: Volumetric clouds. RealEarth drives them: it takes coverage from max(rainLevel, thunderLevel), which this mod now sets per player.

mods.name: YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)
mods.why: Config library. REQUIRED by Better Clouds - it will not load without it.

mods.name: Cold Sweat
mods.why: Body temperature. RealEarth replaces its world temperature with the real climate at your position.

mods.name: Distant Horizons
mods.why: Far-distance LOD terrain. Reads getBaseHeight, so it shows real Earth relief to the horizon with no integration needed.
